name: GPT Live
description: OpenAI's latest real-time voice interface designed to enable natural, flowing conversation. It supports dynamic interruptions, background task delegation to stronger frontier models, and can generate contextual visual responses in the UI.
keyFeatures: Supports natural conversational interruptions and pauses
Delegates complex reasoning tasks to background models like GPT 5.5
Generates live visual UI cards (e.g., weather, stocks) alongside voice responses
